QuestInfo.name: Spring Picnic Treasure Hunt!
QuestInfo.0: Time for a Treasure Hunt to celebrate the spring picnic! If you do well enough, you could receive a gift!\n
QuestInfo.1: Visit Gaga in town and ask him about the Treasure Hunt in detail.
QuestInfo.2: Ha, so if you work really hard in the Treasure Hunt, you can get treasure? Time to get to work, then!

0.0: The Spring Picnic is finally here, #b#h0##k! I hope you know just how much everyone in Maple World has been looking forward to this.\r\n
0.1: I'm sure you've heard that the #rTreasure Hunt#k is the big event of the picnic. Anyone who participates has the chance to win #bgreat prizes#k. If you're interested, I could tell you more, if you like.\r\n

yes.0: While hunting monsters anywhere in Maple World, you can find a #bTreasure Hunt Note#k that looks like this: #i02430251#. Double-click the Treasure Hunt Note in the Use window to read what's inside.
yes.1: Come find me in town when you feel like finding some treasure.

no.0: You sure you want to miss such a great opportunity? Come back if you change your mind.

1.0: It's exciting, isn't it? I mean, you'll have to search hard for great treasures, so don't be discouraged if you find notes that say #rYou Lose!#k
1.1: In fact, if you collect the You Lose! notes and take them to #bHooper#k, he'll trade them for various goods. He came to celebrate the Spring Picnic with the rest of us!
1.2: And anyone who has collected a lot of Treasure Notes during the event can #bwin a raffle prize#k, regardless of what the notes say. So, if you try really hard, you'll surely get something good!
1.3: Just remember, you cannot get notes from monsters that are #r10 levels higher or lower than your own level#k. Monsters that are #bLevel 150 or higher#k will drop notes regardless of the level difference, but they must be pretty scary, right?

default.0: Looks like your level isn't high enough.
